answer: Sybil resistance here is a signal test: each key must post a bond, then grind a per-epoch hashcash stamp over a seed nobody controls before its text is even parsed, so clones pay the same price per identity. Influence then accrues only from countersignatures by peers outside the agent's own subnet, and mutual vouching decays to nothing. A crystal lattice of fakes looks solid but offers no jetty to real work; only verified effort docks.
